question.worked_solution:
Splitting up the integral into the difference of two integrals and evaluating each integral separately, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{4}(2\sqrt{x}-3{x}^{2})\text{d}x & ={\int }_{1}^{4}2\sqrt{x}\,\text{d}x-{\int }_{1}^{4}3{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\cdot \frac{2}{3}{x}^{3/2}\,{|}_{1}^{4}-{x}^{3}\,{|}_{1}^{4} \\  & =\frac{4}{3}({4}^{3/2}-{1}^{3/2})-({4}^{3}-{1}^{3}) \\  & =\frac{4}{3}(8-1)-(64-1) \\  & =\frac{28}{3}-63 \\  & =-\frac{161}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
